outcome: Histopathological findings of placenta creta samples
cohort: 20 women who underwent gravid hysterectomy due to placenta creta between 2006 and 2012.
finding: Uterine damage caused by cesarean sections is associated with poor decidualization, abnormal trophoblastic invasion, incomplete vascular remodeling, fewer multinucleated trophoblasts, and deep infiltrative pathology in placenta creta.
